acceptanceCriteria: Every root README section is audited against immutable public source and current official release assets; confirmed inaccuracies are corrected with original-source evidence.
CLI examples and optional tool descriptions distinguish released builds from newer source experiments and preserve every qualification/authority limit.
All local links and anchors, focused documentation checks, spec-index consistency, independent review and post-commit dogfood/CEM evidence are retained.
Verified change is integrated through the orchestrator and native completion is read back with receipt audit; unresolved integration or qualification remains open.
body: Owner requested a detailed root README audit on 2026-10-02 in orchestrator chat 01a0fa80-f6ff-76d3-8b5f-f6af1226d3e7. Audit baseline public main f51f3c9e6fbfc5a6b219692e8bf46e4e43297a36. Confirmed README contradictions: no optional agent dispatch vs committed Tasks supervisor/dispatcher; historical 0.4.0a4 example; source-only LSP commands without release distinction; implied companion bundle availability despite separately released Core/Tasks assets; appended flow/supervision/editor sections after License. Exact evidence and proposed narrow paths retained at /private/tmp/corvint-readme-audit.md and /private/tmp/corvint-readme-plan.json. Installed Core rc1 build163 and Tasks dev build202 match official channels but retain their qualification limits. No source writes yet. Existing V1-0470 is CI admission and V1-0530 is a spec README; neither owns this root audit.
title: Audit and correct root README release, tool and qualification accuracy
